'''Huwin Clathor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] geode [[Mining/Legends|miner]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]]<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> Clathor operated in the [[Temple Valley]] region of the world and at some point, he had some dealings with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera]].<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Scourge" /> there was an outbreak of a [[Endregaad Plague|deadly viral disease]] on the world, and Clathor contracted the contagion. Clathor was an honest and sharp-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] individual.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
